newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steadies on API drawdown, arb interest.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steadies on API drawdown, arb interest.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to slightly higher on Wednesday after a drop in U.S. inventories and continued arbitrage interest to the States, traders said.
But activity was very quiet as holiday sleepiness crept into the market, crude hovered just below unchanged, and high freight costs limited heavy trans-Atlantic activity, they said.
"There is no talk at all," said one trader, who believed the arb and the American Petroleum Institute data should lend a firm undertone.
Eurograde barges traded at $223 for Rotterdam running refinery material and offers moved up to $225, traders said. Barges for fob ARA were notionally set at $220/$223, unchanged from Tuesday.
No deals were heard for regular unleaded or super unleaded, which traded at $212/$214 and $236/$238 fob ARA, respectively.
API said gasoline stocks last week fell 3.1 million barrels, to 191.5 million, after U.S. traders expected a build of about one million.
